title: Integrative Transcriptomic and Metabolomic Analysis Reveals That Acanthopanax senticosus Fruit Ameliorates Cisplatin-Induced Acute Kidney Injury by Suppressing the NF-kappaB/PI3K-AKT Pathway via UGT1A1 Regulation.
authors: Han, Liu; Tang, Zebo; Ma, Xiangyu; Zhang, Qiuyue; Han, Yu; Wang, Qi; Liu, Jinlong; Bian, Xuefeng; Gao, Liancong; Xu, Mengran; Sun, Xin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究刺五加果提取物缓解顺铂肾损伤的转录组-代谢组机制，虽含分子对接但非蛋白-DNA互作核心，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The chemical composition of the ethanol extract of Acanthopanax senticosus fruit (ASFEE) was systematically characterized using UPLC-MS/MS (Q Exactive Orbitrap), leading to the identification of 45 compounds. Through integrated network pharmacology and molecular docking analyses, the binding affinities between key bioactive constituents-such as eleutheroside E (EE) and quercetin-and core therapeutic targets were predicted and validated. A total of 125 overlapping targets were identified between ASFEE and acute kidney injury (AKI), with significant enrichment observed in critical signaling pathways, including NF-kappaB, IL-17, and PI3K-Akt. To evaluate the protective effects of ASFEE, both in vitro (HK-2 cells) and in vivo (murine) models of cisplatin (DDP)-induced AKI were employed. Parameters assessed included cell viability, apoptosis, reactive oxygen species (ROS) production, activation of the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, kidney function, histopathological alterations, and levels of inflammatory cytokines. ASFEE treatment markedly enhanced HK-2 cell viability and reduced cellular apoptosis and ROS generation. In the murine model, DDP administration resulted in significantly elevated serum creatinine (Scr) and blood urea nitrogen (BUN) levels. Both low- and high-dose ASFEE treatments significantly attenuated these increases, improved overall kidney function, and alleviated kidney tubular damage. Furthermore, ASFEE reduced serum levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines, including IL-1beta, IL-6, and TNF-alpha. Multi-omics integration analysis enabled the identification of differentially expressed genes and metabolites. ASFEE was found to reverse 4689 DDP-induced gene expression changes and 323 metabolic disturbances, with the uridine diphosphate glucuronosyltransferase (UGT)-mediated ascorbic acid metabolism pathway emerging as the central regulatory axis. Key candidate genes and proteins were further validated via real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) and Western blotting. DDP significantly upregulated the expression of inflammatory markers and associated signaling molecules in kidney tissues, while concurrently downregulating UGT family genes and the UGT1A1 protein involved in uronic acid metabolism. Notably, ASFEE treatment effectively counteracted these alterations, confirming its role in enhancing UGT1A1-mediated metabolic processes and suppressing the NF-kappaB/PI3K-Akt/IL-17 signaling cascade. These mechanisms contribute to improved antioxidant capacity, mitigation of inflammatory responses, and restoration of metabolic homeostasis, thereby conferring protection against DDP-induced AKI. ASFEE exerts a protective effect on AKI caused by DDP by enhancing antioxidant capacity, inhibiting inflammation and restoring metabolic homeostasis, providing an experimental basis for its subsequent development and application.
abstract_zh: 采用UPLC-MS/MS（Q Exactive Orbitrap）对刺五加果实乙醇提取物（ASFEE）的化学成分进行了系统表征，鉴定出45种化合物。通过整合网络药理学和分子对接分析，预测并验证了关键生物活性成分（如刺五加苷E（EE）和槲皮素）与核心治疗靶点之间的结合亲和力。在ASFEE与急性肾损伤（AKI）之间共鉴定出125个重叠靶点，并在关键信号通路（包括NF-kappaB、IL-17和PI3K-Akt）中观察到显著富集。为评估ASFEE的保护作用，采用了顺铂（DDP）诱导的AKI体外（HK-2细胞）和体内（小鼠）模型。评估参数包括细胞活力、凋亡、活性氧（ROS）产生、NF-kappaB信号通路激活、肾功能、组织病理学改变及炎症细胞因子水平。ASFEE处理显著提高了HK-2细胞活力，并减少了细胞凋亡和ROS生成。在小鼠模型中，DDP给药导致血清肌酐（Scr）和血尿素氮（BUN）水平显著升高。低剂量和高剂量ASFEE处理均显著减轻了这些升高，改善了整体肾功能，并减轻了肾小管损伤。此外，ASFEE降低了血清中促炎细胞因子（包括IL-1beta、IL-6和TNF-alpha）的水平。多组学整合分析能够识别差异表达基因和代谢物。ASFEE被发现逆转了4689个DDP诱导的基因表达变化和323个代谢紊乱，其中尿苷二磷酸葡萄糖醛酸转移酶（UGT）介导的抗坏血酸代谢通路成为核心调控轴。关键候选基因和蛋白质通过实时定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）和Western blotting进一步验证。DDP显著上调了肾组织中炎症标志物及相关信号分子的表达，同时下调了参与糖醛酸代谢的UGT家族基因和UGT1A1蛋白。值得注意的是，ASFEE处理有效抵消了这些变化，证实了其在增强UGT1A1介导的代谢过程和抑制NF-kappaB/PI3K-Akt/IL-17信号级联中的作用。这些机制有助于提高抗氧化能力、减轻炎症反应和恢复代谢稳态，从而赋予对DDP诱导的AKI的保护作用。ASFEE通过增强抗氧化能力、抑制炎症和恢复代谢稳态，对DDP引起的AKI发挥保护作用，为其后续开发和应用提供了实验依据。
